verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents an official command-line path for skills through Claude Code. You can register the repo with `/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills`, install skill bundles with `/plugin install`, test plugins locally with the `--plugin-dir` flag, and run headless with `claude -p`. However, there is no dedicated Skills CLI; these commands live inside the Claude Code agent, and the standalone `npx skills add` installer is described as third-party tooling. Missing for 10: a dedicated official Skills CLI for creating, validating, and publishing skills; documented scriptable skill-management commands outside the Claude Code session; independent hands-on corroboration of the official CLI workflow.
